hints.content:
The greatest common factor of $9b^8$ and $24b^3$ is $3b^3$.

[[☃ explanation 1]]

Now we need to factor $3b^3$ out of $9b^8+24b^3$.

options.explanation:
We find the prime factors of each term:

$\begin{align}
9b^8&=\blueD{(3)}(3)\goldD{(b)(b)(b)}(b)(b)(b)(b)(b)
\\\\
24b^3&=\blueD{(3)}(2)(2)(2)\goldD{(b)(b)(b)}
\end{align}$

The greatest common factor is the product of all the shared parts:

$\blueD{(3)}\goldD{(b)(b)(b)}=3b^3$
